_comment: Days since each account's last play. plex: the server's watch history. tautulli: get_users_table last_seen (null = no date).
_comment_library_plays: Plays as [account id, library key, days ago]. Account 1 is the owner, library 99 no longer exists, and an empty key is a play with no library. Tautulli also records unfinished plays (alex's movie 10 days ago).
